requirement: A guest can check in after midnight without making any prior arrangement.
meaning_constraints: Use varied counterexamples: must request code in advance; check-in closes before midnight; overnight arrivals refused; desk 24h but actual check-in not; late arrival needs prior approval.

clauses.text: Q: How do I enter after midnight? A: Guests arriving after midnight must use a specific access code, which must be requested at least one day in advance.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the midnight timing, the requirement for a code, and the one-day advance request condition.

clauses.text: Dear Client, please note that while the desk operates overnight, any arrivals scheduled after midnight will require advance approval to ensure access.

clauses.text: *Please note: The property refuses all check-ins between the hours of midnight and 06:00.
